import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { setTimeout } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { expect, it } from 'vitest';

const file = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const level = basename(dirname(file));
const slot = `${level}-active`;

it('has the worker slot to itself', async () => {
  expect(() => mkdirSync(slot)).not.toThrow();
  try {
    // Yield long enough for competing files to enter their tests. No elapsed-time assertion
    // or CPU load is needed: creating the same directory concurrently is the failure.
    await setTimeout(250);
    writeFileSync(join('completed', `${level}-${basename(file)}`), 'finished');
  } finally {
    rmSync(slot, { recursive: true });
  }
});
